name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Charmander
flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
flavorText: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

name: Pidgeot
flavorText: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Alolan Rattata

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 20, during the night

flavorText: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Raticate
flavorText: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavorText: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
flavorText: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

name: Ekans
flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
flavorText: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

name: Pikachu

evolvesTo.description: Use a Thunder Stone on it
Use a Thunder Stone on it, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/pikachu Alolabiome)

flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Alolan Pikachu

evolvesTo.description: Use a Thunder Stone on it, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/pikachu Kantobiome)
Use a Thunder Stone on it

flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Raichu
flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Alolan Raichu
flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

name: Alolan Sandshrew

evolvesTo.description: Use an Ice Stone on it

flavorText: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavorText: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.

name: Nidoran-F
flavorText: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

name: Nidorina

evolvesTo.description: Use a Moon Stone on it

flavorText: The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get poked while their mother is feeding them.

name: Nidoqueen
flavorText: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.

name: Nidoran-M
flavorText: The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

name: Nidorino

evolvesTo.description: Use a Moon Stone on it

flavorText: With a horn that’s harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.

name: Nidoking
flavorText: When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

name: Clefairy

evolvesTo.description: Use a Moon Stone on it

flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Vulpix

evolvesTo.description: Use a Fire Stone on it

flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Alolan Vulpix

evolvesTo.description: Use an Ice Stone on it

flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Jigglypuff

evolvesTo.description: Use a Moon Stone on it

flavorText: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavorText: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.

name: Oddish
flavorText: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom

evolvesTo.description: Use a Leaf Stone on it
Use a Sun Stone on it

flavorText: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Paras
flavorText: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

name: Parasect
flavorText: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back. The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.

name: Venonat
flavorText: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

name: Venomoth
flavorText: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

name: Diglett
flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

name: Dugtrio
flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavorText: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavorText: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Persian
flavorText: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

name: Alolan Persian
flavorText: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If the Pokémon lets its strange power erupt, apparently the pain subsides for a while.

name: Golduck
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

name: Mankey
flavorText: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

name: Primeape

evolvesTo.description: Level up, after using Ragefist 20 times

flavorText: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

name: Growlithe

evolvesTo.description: Use a Fire Stone on it

flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Hisuian Growlithe

evolvesTo.description: Use a Fire Stone on it

flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Poliwag
flavorText: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl

evolvesTo.description: Use a Water Stone on it
Trade while holding a King's Rock (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Poliwrath
flavorText: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Abra
flavorText: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
flavorText: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam
flavorText: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Machop
flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Bellsprout
flavorText: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

name: Weepinbell

evolvesTo.description: Use a Leaf Stone on it

flavorText: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

name: Victreebel
flavorText: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

name: Tentacool
flavorText: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

name: Tentacruel
flavorText: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Geodude
flavorText: Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavorText: Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.

name: Graveler
flavorText: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavorText: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

name: Golem
flavorText: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.

name: Alolan Golem
flavorText: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.

name: Ponyta
flavorText: It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Galarian Ponyta
flavorText: It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
flavorText: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Galarian Rapidash
flavorText: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Slowpoke

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a King's Rock (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.

name: Galarian Slowpoke

evolvesTo.description: Use a Galarica Cuff on it
Use a Galarica Wreath on it

flavorText: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

name: Galarian Slowbro
flavorText: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a grounded Magnemite, it’ll start moving again.

name: Magneton

evolvesTo.description: Use a Thunder Stone on it

flavorText: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

name: Farfetch’d
flavorText: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Galarian Farfetch’d
flavorText: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Doduo
flavorText: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

name: Dodrio
flavorText: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

name: Seel
flavorText: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

name: Grimer
flavorText: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavorText: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

name: Muk
flavorText: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

name: Alolan Muk
flavorText: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

name: Shellder

evolvesTo.description: Use a Water Stone on it

flavorText: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

name: Cloyster
flavorText: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

name: Gastly
flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

name: Haunter
flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

name: Gengar
flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.

name: Onix

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Metal Coat (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

name: Hypno
flavorText: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

name: Krabby
flavorText: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler
flavorText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Voltorb
flavorText: It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.

name: Hisuian Voltorb

evolvesTo.description: Use a Leaf Stone on it

flavorText: It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.

name: Electrode
flavorText: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.

name: Hisuian Electrode
flavorText: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.

name: Exeggcute

evolvesTo.description: Use a Leaf Stone on it
Use a Leaf Stone on it, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/exeggcute Alolabiome)

flavorText: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Alolan Exeggcute

Use a Leaf Stone on it

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavorText: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Cubone

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 28, during the night, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/cubone Alolabiome)
Level up to level 28, in a matching biome (Is Nether)

flavorText: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Alolan Cubone

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 28, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/cubone Kantobiome)
Level up to level 28, during the night
Level up to level 28, in a matching biome (Is Nether)

flavorText: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
flavorText: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavorText: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

name: Hitmonlee
flavorText: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

name: Hitmonchan
flavorText: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

name: Lickitung
flavorText: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.

name: Koffing

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 35, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/koffing Galarbiome)

flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Galarian Koffing

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 35, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/koffing Kantobiome)

flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Weezing
flavorText: It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.

name: Galarian Weezing
flavorText: It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.

name: Rhyhorn
flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

name: Rhydon

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Protector (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Chansey
flavorText: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It’s used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Kangaskhan
flavorText: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Horsea
flavorText: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Dragon Scale (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

name: Seaking
flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Staryu

evolvesTo.description: Use a Water Stone on it

flavorText: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
flavorText: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Mr. Mime
flavorText: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavorText: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Scyther

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Metal Coat (item is used up in the trade)
Use a Black Augurite on it

flavorText: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

name: Jynx
flavorText: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Electabuzz

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding an Electirizer (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Magmar

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Magmarizer (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Pinsir
flavorText: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Tauros
flavorText: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavorText: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Lapras
flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Ditto
flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Eevee

evolvesTo.description: Use a Thunder Stone on it
Use a Water Stone on it
Use a Fire Stone on it
Level up, with 160+ friendship, during the day
Level up, with 160+ friendship, during the night
Level up, with 160+ friendship, knowing a Fairy-type move
Use a Leaf Stone on it
Use an Ice Stone on it

flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Vaporeon
flavorText: When Vaporeon’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Jolteon
flavorText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Flareon
flavorText: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon’s body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding an Upgrade (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Omanyte
flavorText: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

name: Omastar
flavorText: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

name: Kabuto
flavorText: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

name: Kabutops
flavorText: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

name: Aerodactyl
flavorText: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Articuno
flavorText: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Galarian Articuno
flavorText: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Zapdos
flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Galarian Zapdos
flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Moltres
flavorText: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Galarian Moltres
flavorText: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Dratini
flavorText: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

name: Dragonite
flavorText: It’s a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

name: Mewtwo
flavorText: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

name: Mew
flavorText: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

name: Bayleef
flavorText: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

name: Meganium
flavorText: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Hisuian Cyndaquil
flavorText: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 36, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/quilava Hisuibiome)

flavorText: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Hisuian Quilava

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 36, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/quilava Johtobiome)

flavorText: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Typhlosion
flavorText: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Hisuian Typhlosion
flavorText: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Totodile
flavorText: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

name: Feraligatr
flavorText: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

name: Sentret
flavorText: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

name: Furret
flavorText: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

name: Hoothoot
flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavorText: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Ledyba
flavorText: Ledyba secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This Pokémon conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.

name: Ledian
flavorText: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live Ledian in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this—the Pokémon uses the light of the stars as its energy.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: The web spun by Spinarak can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this Pokémon can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.

name: Ariados
flavorText: Ariados’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This Pokémon constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.

name: Chinchou
flavorText: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Lanturn
flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Pichu
flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: Alolan Pichu
flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: Cleffa
flavorText: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

name: Igglybuff
flavorText: Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like body gives off a faint sweet smell.

name: Togepi
flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic

evolvesTo.description: Use a Shiny Stone on it

flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Natu
flavorText: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Mareep’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: Flaaffy’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: Ampharos gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokémon to send signals back and forth with others far away.

name: Bellossom
flavorText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Marill
flavorText: This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. The ball of Marill’s tail is filled with nutrients that have been turned into an oil.

name: Azumarill
flavorText: It spends most of its time in the water. On sunny days, Azumarill floats on the surface of the water and sunbathes.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’s a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

name: Politoed
flavorText: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Hoppip
flavorText: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

name: Jumpluff
flavorText: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

name: Aipom
flavorText: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Sunkern

evolvesTo.description: Use a Sun Stone on it

flavorText: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

name: Sunflora
flavorText: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

name: Yanma
flavorText: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Wooper
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Espeon
flavorText: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.

name: Umbreon
flavorText: When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent’s eyes.

name: Murkrow

evolvesTo.description: Use a Dusk Stone on it

flavorText: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

name: Slowking
flavorText: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.

name: Galarian Slowking
flavorText: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.

name: Misdreavus

evolvesTo.description: Use a Dusk Stone on it

flavorText: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Unown
flavorText: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

name: Wobbuffet
flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

name: Girafarig
flavorText: Girafarig’s rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.

name: Pineco
flavorText: Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.

name: Forretress
flavorText: Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.

name: Dunsparce
flavorText: This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.

name: Gligar

evolvesTo.description: Level up, holding a Razor Fang, during the night

flavorText: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

name: Steelix
flavorText: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, Snubbull sends smaller Pokémon scurrying away in terror. However, this Pokémon seems a little sad at making its foes flee.

name: Granbull
flavorText: Granbull has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the Pokémon to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent’s size.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish
flavorText: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent’s size.

name: Scizor
flavorText: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor’s body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Heracross
flavorText: Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.

name: Sneasel

evolvesTo.description: Level up, holding a Razor Claw, during the night

flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Hisuian Sneasel

evolvesTo.description: Level up, holding a Razor Claw, during the day

flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Teddiursa
flavorText: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring

evolvesTo.description: Use a Peat Block on it, during a Full Moon, during the night

flavorText: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Molten magma courses throughout Slugma’s circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.

name: Magcargo
flavorText: Magcargo’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile—just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Corsola
flavorText: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavorText: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Mantine
flavorText: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.

name: Houndour
flavorText: Houndour hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon’s remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply toward the back serves a leadership role. These Pokémon choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

name: Kingdra
flavorText: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: For its nest, Phanpy digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.

name: Donphan
flavorText: Donphan’s favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can’t stop very easily.

name: Porygon2

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Dubious Disc (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Stantler
flavorText: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: Smeargle marks the boundaries of its territory using a body fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. Over 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.

name: Tyrogue

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 20, with higher Defence than Attack
Level up to level 20, with higher Attack than Defence
Level up to level 20, with equal Attack and Defence

flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Smoochum
flavorText: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.

name: Elekid
flavorText: When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder, it gets full-on rowdy.

name: Magby
flavorText: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Miltank
flavorText: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Blissey
flavorText: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

name: Raikou
flavorText: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

name: Entei
flavorText: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

name: Larvitar
flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Tyranitar
flavorText: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Lugia
flavorText: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

name: Celebi
flavorText: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

name: Treecko
flavorText: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

name: Grovyle
flavorText: The leaves growing out of Grovyle’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

name: Sceptile
flavorText: The leaves growing on Sceptile’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile—it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

name: Torchic
flavorText: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

name: Combusken
flavorText: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.

name: Blaziken
flavorText: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon’s wrists burn.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: The fin on Mudkip’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

name: Marshtomp
flavorText: The surface of Marshtomp’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

name: Swampert
flavorText: Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

name: Zigzagoon
flavorText: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavorText: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.

name: Linoone
flavorText: Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.

name: Galarian Linoone

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 35, during the night

flavorText: Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.

name: Wurmple

evolvesTo.description: Level up to 7 -- becomes either Silcoon or Cascoon. Which one is decided randomly the moment Wurmple is generated (caught/hatched), not something you can influence at evolution time.
Level up to 7 -- becomes either Silcoon or Cascoon. Which one is decided randomly the moment Wurmple is generated (caught/hatched), not something you can influence at evolution time.

flavorText: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

name: Dustox
flavorText: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Lotad
flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Lombre

evolvesTo.description: Use a Water Stone on it

flavorText: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo’s cells, making it more powerful.

name: Seedot
flavorText: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf

evolvesTo.description: Use a Leaf Stone on it

flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.

name: Taillow
flavorText: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

name: Swellow
flavorText: Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow’s clawed feet, preventing escape.

name: Wingull
flavorText: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

name: Pelipper
flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

name: Ralts
flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia

evolvesTo.description: Use a Dawn Stone on it

flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Surskit
flavorText: From the tips of its feet, Surskit secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.

name: Masquerain
flavorText: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction—even sideways and backwards—as if it were a helicopter.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

name: Breloom
flavorText: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.

name: Slaking
flavorText: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.

name: Nincada

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 20 (also produces a free Shedinja -- needs an empty Poke Ball and party space)

flavorText: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

name: Shedinja
flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

name: Whismur
flavorText: The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.

name: Loudred
flavorText: Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

name: Exploud
flavorText: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: Makuhita is tenacious—it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: Hariyama practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.

name: Azurill
flavorText: The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.

name: Nosepass

evolvesTo.description: Use a Thunder Stone on it

flavorText: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

name: Skitty

evolvesTo.description: Use a Moon Stone on it

flavorText: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

name: Sableye
flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.

name: Mawile
flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Aron
flavorText: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavorText: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

name: Aggron
flavorText: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

name: Meditite
flavorText: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

name: Medicham
flavorText: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

name: Electrike
flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Plusle
flavorText: Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

name: Minun
flavorText: Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

name: Volbeat
flavorText: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.

name: Illumise
flavorText: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

name: Roselia

evolvesTo.description: Use a Shiny Stone on it

flavorText: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

name: Gulpin
flavorText: Virtually all of Gulpin’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

name: Swalot
flavorText: When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Numel
flavorText: Numel is extremely dull witted—it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Spoink
flavorText: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

name: Spinda
flavorText: All the Spinda that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

name: Swablu
flavorText: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

name: Altaria
flavorText: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

name: Seviper
flavorText: Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.

name: Solrock
flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Barboach
flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

name: Whiscash
flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

name: Corphish
flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
flavorText: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Lileep
flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.

name: Cradily
flavorText: It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.

name: Anorith
flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

name: Armaldo
flavorText: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

name: Feebas

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Prism Scale (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Castform
flavorText: Castform’s appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

name: Kecleon
flavorText: Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception—this Pokémon can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: Shuppet is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.

name: Banette
flavorText: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

name: Duskull
flavorText: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it’s said.

name: Dusclops

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Reaper Cloth (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Tropius
flavorText: The bunches of fruit around Tropius’s neck are very popular with children. This Pokémon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.

name: Chimecho
flavorText: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

name: Absol
flavorText: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Wynaut
flavorText: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

name: Snorunt

evolvesTo.description: Use a Dawn Stone on it

flavorText: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

name: Glalie
flavorText: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

name: Spheal
flavorText: This Pokémon’s body is covered in blubber and impressively round. It’s faster for Spheal to roll around than walk.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: Sealeo live on top of drift ice. They go swimming when they’re on the hunt, seeking out their prey by scent.

name: Walrein
flavorText: Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals. When a threat appears, the herd’s leader will protect the group with its life.

name: Clamperl

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Deep Sea Tooth (item is used up in the trade)
Trade while holding a Deep Sea Scale (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: Clamperl’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection—it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

name: Huntail
flavorText: Huntail’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.

name: Gorebyss
flavorText: Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Luvdisc
flavorText: Luvdisc live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.

name: Bagon
flavorText: Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to grow stronger so that someday it will be able to fly.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.

name: Salamence
flavorText: Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it was able to evolve a body with wings just by constantly wishing to be able to fly.

name: Beldum
flavorText: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum’s sharp claws.

name: Metang
flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Metagross
flavorText: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

name: Regirock
flavorText: Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.

name: Regice
flavorText: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

name: Registeel
flavorText: Registeel’s body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

name: Latias
flavorText: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

name: Latios
flavorText: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.

name: Kyogre
mechanics: Primal Reversion: give Kyogre a Blue Orb to hold to permanently boost its stats/ability while it's holding the orb, similar to a Mega Evolution.
flavorText: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

name: Groudon
mechanics: Primal Reversion: give Groudon a Red Orb to hold to permanently boost its stats/ability while it's holding the orb, similar to a Mega Evolution.
flavorText: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.

name: Jirachi
flavorText: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near- perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

name: Deoxys
mechanics: Has 4 formes (Normal/Attack/Defense/Speed) that trade off stats. Change forme by right-clicking Deoxys with a Deoxys Meteorite.
flavorText: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

name: Grotle

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 32, holding an Oak Sapling
Level up to level 32, holding a Birch Sapling
Level up to level 32, holding a Dark Oak Sapling
Level up to level 32, holding an Acacia Sapling
Level up to level 32, holding an Azalea Tree
Level up to level 32, holding a Jungle Sapling
Level up to level 32, holding a Spruce Sapling
Level up to level 32, holding a Mangrove Propagule
Level up to level 32, holding a Cherry Sapling

flavorText: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

name: Torterra
flavorText: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

name: Chimchar
flavorText: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

name: Monferno
flavorText: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

name: Infernape
flavorText: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

name: Empoleon
flavorText: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

name: Starly
flavorText: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

name: Staravia
flavorText: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

name: Bidoof
flavorText: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

name: Bibarel
flavorText: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

name: Kricketot
flavorText: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

name: Kricketune
flavorText: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Shinx
flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

name: Luxio
flavorText: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio’s electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

name: Budew

evolvesTo.description: Level up, with 160+ friendship, during the day

flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

name: Roserade
flavorText: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Cranidos
flavorText: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

name: Rampardos
flavorText: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

name: Burmy
flavorText: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

name: Mothim
flavorText: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

name: Combee
