flavorText: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

name: Vespiquen
flavorText: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

name: Cherubi
flavorText: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly waiting for sunlight to appear.

name: Shellos
flavorText: This Pokémon’s habitat shapes its physique. According to some theories, life in warm ocean waters causes this variation to develop.

name: Gastrodon
flavorText: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

name: Buneary
flavorText: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

name: Glameow
flavorText: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
flavorText: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

name: Chingling

evolvesTo.description: Level up, with 160+ friendship, during the night

flavorText: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

name: Stunky
flavorText: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon’s diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn’t come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

name: Bonsly
flavorText: It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes. The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have a slight bitterness.

name: Mime Jr.

evolvesTo.description: Level up, knowing Mimic, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/mimejr Galarbiome)

flavorText: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.

name: Galarian Mime Jr.

evolvesTo.description: Level up, knowing Mimic, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/mimejr Sinnohbiome)

flavorText: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.

name: Happiny

evolvesTo.description: Level up, holding an Oval Stone, during the day

flavorText: Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg- shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.

name: Chatot
flavorText: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

name: Gible
flavorText: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

name: Gabite
flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

name: Garchomp
flavorText: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

name: Munchlax
flavorText: Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is its only concern. Whether the food is rotten or fresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.

name: Riolu

evolvesTo.description: Level up, with 160+ friendship, during the day

flavorText: It’s exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

name: Drapion
flavorText: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

name: Finneon
flavorText: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

name: Lumineon
flavorText: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

name: Mantyke

evolvesTo.description: Level up, with a Remoraid in your party

flavorText: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.

name: Snover
flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it’s being controlled by some mysterious being.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Electivire
flavorText: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Magmortar
flavorText: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Yanmega
flavorText: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokémon’s leaves. There’s a popular perfume made using that scent.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: Any who become captivated by the beauty of the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen before they know it.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Gallade
flavorText: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Froslass
flavorText: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

name: Rotom
flavorText: One boy’s invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom’s unique capabilities.

name: Uxie
flavorText: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

name: Mesprit
flavorText: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

name: Azelf
flavorText: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

name: Dialga
mechanics: Origin Forme via holding an Adamant Crystal.
flavorText: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

name: Palkia
mechanics: Origin Forme via holding a Lustrous Globe.
flavorText: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

name: Regigigas
flavorText: All over the world, there are legends that tell of Regigigas creating other Pokémon in its own image.

name: Giratina
mechanics: Origin Forme via holding a Griseous Core.
flavorText: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

name: Phione
flavorText: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

name: Shaymin
mechanics: Land Form <-> Sky Form via right-clicking with a Gracidea Flower. Using it during the day changes Land -> Sky (becomes Grass/Flying, more offense/speed); using it at night changes Sky -> Land (more bulk).
flavorText: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Arceus
mechanics: Changes type (Multitype) by right-clicking with the matching type Plate (Draco Plate, Flame Plate, Splash Plate, etc. -- all 17 non-Normal plates are craftable on this server).
flavorText: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Snivy
flavorText: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

name: Servine
flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Serperior
flavorText: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Hisuian Oshawott
flavorText: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Dewott

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 36, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/dewott Hisuibiome)

flavorText: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Hisuian Dewott

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 36, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/dewott Unovabiome)

flavorText: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Samurott
flavorText: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Hisuian Samurott
flavorText: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

name: Herdier
flavorText: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavorText: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Pansage

evolvesTo.description: Use a Leaf Stone on it

flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Simisage
flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

name: Pansear

evolvesTo.description: Use a Fire Stone on it

flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Simisear
flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Panpour

evolvesTo.description: Use a Water Stone on it

flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Munna

evolvesTo.description: Use a Moon Stone on it

flavorText: Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

name: Musharna
flavorText: When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

name: Pidove
flavorText: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you’re scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Blitzle
flavorText: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: It’s as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.

name: Boldore
flavorText: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.

name: Woobat
flavorText: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
flavorText: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.

name: Audino
flavorText: Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino’s ears.

name: Timburr
flavorText: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

name: Conkeldurr
flavorText: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

name: Tympole
flavorText: Graceful ripples running across the water’s surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

name: Throh
flavorText: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.

name: Sawk
flavorText: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Venipede
flavorText: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

name: Scolipede
flavorText: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.

name: Cottonee

evolvesTo.description: Use a Sun Stone on it

flavorText: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Petilil

evolvesTo.description: Use a Sun Stone on it, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/petilil Hisuibiome)
Use a Sun Stone on it

flavorText: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.

name: Hisuian Petilil

evolvesTo.description: Use a Sun Stone on it, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/petilil Unovabiome)
Use a Sun Stone on it

flavorText: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.

name: Lilligant
flavorText: It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head to bloom.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavorText: It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head to bloom.

name: Basculin
flavorText: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavorText: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.

name: Sandile
flavorText: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

name: Galarian Darumaka

evolvesTo.description: Use an Ice Stone on it

flavorText: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavorText: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Maractus
flavorText: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

name: Dwebble
flavorText: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.

name: Crustle
flavorText: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

name: Scrafty
flavorText: As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.

name: Yamask
flavorText: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.

name: Galarian Yamask

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 0, in a matching biome (Is Sandy)

flavorText: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

name: Tirtouga
flavorText: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.

name: Carracosta
flavorText: Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones, shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta’s own shell grows thick and sturdy.

name: Archen
flavorText: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it’s very good at jumping.

name: Archeops
flavorText: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Zorua
flavorText: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua’s ability to take on the forms of other creatures.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavorText: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua’s ability to take on the forms of other creatures.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.

name: Hisuian Zoroark
flavorText: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.

name: Minccino

evolvesTo.description: Use a Shiny Stone on it

flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It’s also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

name: Solosis
flavorText: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

name: Duosion
flavorText: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Vanillish
flavorText: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Deerling
flavorText: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

name: Emolga
flavorText: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Karrablast

evolvesTo.description: Use a Shell Helmet on it

flavorText: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Escavalier
flavorText: They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They’re very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

name: Foongus
flavorText: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’ll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

name: Frillish
flavorText: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean’s surface.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: Most of this Pokémon’s body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavorText: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Klink
flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik

evolvesTo.description: Use a Thunder Stone on it

flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Elgyem
flavorText: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem
flavorText: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

name: Litwick
flavorText: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

name: Lampent

evolvesTo.description: Use a Dusk Stone on it

flavorText: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it’s feared as an emissary of death.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Axew
flavorText: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other’s strength.

name: Fraxure
flavorText: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

name: Haxorus
flavorText: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn’t like.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: With its icy chains, Cryogonal freezes those it encounters. It then takes its victims away to somewhere unknown.

name: Shelmet

evolvesTo.description: Use a Link Cable on it, with a Karrablast in your party

flavorText: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

name: Accelgor
flavorText: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavorText: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
flavorText: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.

name: Golett
flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk
flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bisharp

evolvesTo.description: Level up, after defeating 3 Pokemon while it holds a King's Rock

flavorText: It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

name: Rufflet

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 54, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/rufflet Hisuibiome)

flavorText: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can’t resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.

name: Hisuian Rufflet

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 54, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/rufflet Unovabiome)

flavorText: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can’t resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.

name: Braviary
flavorText: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.

name: Hisuian Braviary
flavorText: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they’re ready to leave the nest.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Durant
flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Deino
flavorText: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

name: Volcarona
flavorText: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Virizion
flavorText: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

name: Tornadus
mechanics: Incarnate Forme <-> Therian Forme by right-clicking with a Reveal Glass (craftable on this server).
flavorText: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

name: Thundurus
mechanics: Incarnate Forme <-> Therian Forme by right-clicking with a Reveal Glass (craftable on this server).
flavorText: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémon will scorch the world.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Landorus
mechanics: Incarnate Forme <-> Therian Forme by right-clicking with a Reveal Glass (craftable on this server).
flavorText: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

name: Kyurem
mechanics: Fuses with Zekrom or Reshiram using DNA Splicers: right-click Zekrom/Reshiram with the Splicers first to charge them, then right-click Kyurem with the charged Splicers. Zekrom -> Black Kyurem, Reshiram -> White Kyurem. The fusion inherits Kyurem's IVs/EVs/shiny/level.
flavorText: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Chespin
flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Quilladin
flavorText: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: Chesnaught
flavorText: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Braixen
flavorText: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Delphox
flavorText: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It’s a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder’s sharp talons finish it off.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: Spewpa

evolvesTo.description: Level up to 12 -- becomes a Vivillon whose wing pattern is set by the real-world biome you're in at the time (20 possible patterns; a few need a Village nearby or far away, or a special catching achievement).

flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Vivillon
flavorText: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

name: Litleo
flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Flabebe
flavorText: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Floette

evolvesTo.description: Use a Shiny Stone on it

flavorText: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: Florges
flavorText: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Pancham

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 32, with a Type=dark in your party

flavorText: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master’s actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Espurr
flavorText: Though Espurr’s expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.

name: Honedge
flavorText: Honedge’s soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge’s body.

name: Doublade

evolvesTo.description: Use a Dusk Stone on it

flavorText: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

name: Spritzee

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Sachet (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: A scent pouch within this Pokémon’s body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.

name: Aromatisse
flavorText: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon’s companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.

name: Swirlix

evolvesTo.description: Trade while holding a Whipped Dream (item is used up in the trade)

flavorText: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Inkay

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 30, knowing Topsyturvy
Level up to level 30, if nicknamed "Dinnerbone"
Level up to level 30, if nicknamed "Grumm"

flavorText: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
flavorText: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar’s control.

name: Binacle
flavorText: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Skrelp
flavorText: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

name: Dragalge
flavorText: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

name: Clauncher
flavorText: Clauncher’s claws can fall off during battle, but they’ll regenerate. The meat inside the claws is popular as a delicacy in Galar.

name: Clawitzer
flavorText: After using the feelers on its oversized claw to detect the location of prey, Clawitzer launches a cannonball of water at its target.

name: Helioptile

evolvesTo.description: Use a Sun Stone on it

flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

name: Tyrunt

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 39, during the day

flavorText: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it’ll tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.

name: Tyrantrum
flavorText: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000 years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.

name: Amaura

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 39, during the night

flavorText: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind in cold lands where there were fewer predators.

name: Aurorus
flavorText: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It’s said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.

name: Sylveon
flavorText: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: A Dedenne’s whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

name: Carbink
flavorText: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

name: Goomy

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 40, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/goomy Hisuibiome)

flavorText: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It’s considered the weakest dragon Pokémon.

name: Hisuian Goomy

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 40, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/goomy Kalosbiome)

flavorText: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It’s considered the weakest dragon Pokémon.

name: Sliggoo

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 50, while it's raining, in a matching biome (Is Overworld)

flavorText: Although this Pokémon isn’t very strong, its body is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through anything, so predators steer clear of it.

name: Hisuian Sliggoo

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 50, while it's raining, in a matching biome (Is Overworld)

flavorText: Although this Pokémon isn’t very strong, its body is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through anything, so predators steer clear of it.

name: Goodra
flavorText: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don’t mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.

name: Hisuian Goodra
flavorText: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don’t mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.

name: Klefki
flavorText: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

name: Phantump
flavorText: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo’s body. They’re then moved on to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist
flavorText: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

name: Bergmite

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 37, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/bergmite Hisuibiome)

flavorText: They chill the air around them to −150 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.

name: Hisuian Bergmite

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 37, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/bergmite Kalosbiome)

flavorText: They chill the air around them to −150 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.

name: Avalugg
flavorText: At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.

name: Hisuian Avalugg
flavorText: At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.

name: Noibat
flavorText: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

name: Noivern
flavorText: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Xerneas
flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Zygarde
mechanics: Not caught wild -- assembled at a Reassembly Unit block using a Zygarde Cube loaded with Zygarde Cells/Cores (found in Mega Showdown structures): 9 cells+1 core = 10% Forme (Aura Break, ~2 min), 49 cells+1 core = 50% Forme (Aura Break, ~5 min), 95 cells+5 cores = 50% Forme with Power Construct (~10 min). Right-click the Reassembly Unit with a Pokeball when it's done to receive it. Small shiny chance (1/4096) on assembly.
A 50% Forme Zygarde with the Power Construct ability can reach 100% (Complete) Forme in battle when it drops below half HP.
flavorText: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: Diancie
flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Hoopa
mechanics: Hoopa Confined -> Hoopa Unbound by right-clicking it with a Prison Bottle.
flavorText: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Hisuian Rowlet
flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 36, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/dartrix Hisuibiome)

flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Hisuian Dartrix

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 34, in a matching biome (Evolution/regional/dartrix Alolabiome)

flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Decidueye
flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye’s shots never miss.

name: Hisuian Decidueye
flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye’s shots never miss.

name: Litten
flavorText: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

name: Torracat
flavorText: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat’s neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.

name: Incineroar
flavorText: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Popplio
flavorText: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer force of their bursting is what deals damage.

name: Brionne
flavorText: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it’s busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.

name: Primarina
flavorText: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to control its water balloons.

name: Pikipek
flavorText: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

name: Trumbeak
flavorText: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

name: Toucannon
flavorText: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

name: Yungoos

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 20, during the day

flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: Gumshoos
flavorText: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Charjabug

evolvesTo.description: Use a Thunder Stone on it

flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Crabrawler

evolvesTo.description: Use an Ice Stone on it

flavorText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: Crabominable
flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: Oricorio
flavorText: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: Cutiefly
flavorText: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur’s pollen.

name: Ribombee
flavorText: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs’ effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Rockruff

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 25, during the day
Level up to level 25, during the night

flavorText: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Lycanroc
flavorText: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.

name: Wishiwashi
flavorText: Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by gathering up into schools that they’re able to confront opponents.

name: Mareanie
flavorText: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it’s impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Toxapex
flavorText: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Mudbray
flavorText: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It’s skilled at making use of mud.

name: Mudsdale
flavorText: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale’s legs sets harder than stone. It’s so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

name: Dewpider
flavorText: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
flavorText: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Fomantis

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 34, during the day

flavorText: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.

name: Lurantis
flavorText: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.

name: Morelull
flavorText: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic
flavorText: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Salandit
flavorText: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit’s poisonous gas.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

name: Stufful
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavorText: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Bounsweet
flavorText: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

name: Steenee
flavorText: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

name: Tsareena
flavorText: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Comfey
flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.

name: Oranguru
flavorText: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

name: Passimian
flavorText: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Sandygast
flavorText: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

name: Palossand
flavorText: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

name: Pyukumuku
flavorText: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon being created in the Galar region.

name: Silvally
mechanics: Changes type (RKS System) by right-clicking with the matching Memory Disk (Bug Memory, Water Memory, etc. -- all 17 non-Normal memories are craftable on this server).
flavorText: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.

name: Minior
flavorText: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: Komala
flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: Drampa
flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Dhelmise
flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Jangmo-o
flavorText: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Hakamo-o
flavorText: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

name: Kommo-o
flavorText: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Tapu Koko
flavorText: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

name: Tapu Lele
flavorText: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavorText: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

name: Tapu Fini
flavorText: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

name: Cosmoem

evolvesTo.description: Level up to level 53, during the day
Level up to level 53, during the night

flavorText: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’s growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

name: Solgaleo
flavorText: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

name: Lunala
flavorText: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

name: Nihilego
flavorText: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

name: Buzzwole
flavorText: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

name: Pheromosa
flavorText: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: Xurkitree
flavorText: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

name: Celesteela
flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: Kartana
flavorText: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

name: Guzzlord
flavorText: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.

name: Necrozma
mechanics: Fuses with Solgaleo (N-Solarizer) or Lunala (N-Lunarizer): right-click the donor Pokemon with the item first to charge it, then right-click Necrozma with the charged item to become Dusk Mane or Dawn Wings Necrozma. Fusion inherits Necrozma's IVs/EVs/shiny/level.

From Dusk Mane or Dawn Wings, holding Ultranecrozium-Z lets it Ultra Burst into Ultra Necrozma -- in battle with a Z-Ring worn (click the Ultra Burst button before using its Z-move), or outside of battle by shift-right-clicking it (needs the outSideUltraBurst config option enabled).
flavorText: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.

name: Magearna
flavorText: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: Marshadow
flavorText: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

name: Poipole
flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
flavorText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Stakataka
flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Blacephalon
flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Zeraora
flavorText: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Meltan
flavorText: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavorText: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Grookey
flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Thwackey
flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Rillaboom
flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Scorbunny
flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

name: Raboot
flavorText: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Cinderace
flavorText: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: Sobble
flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.

name: Drizzile
flavorText: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Inteleon
flavorText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.

name: Rookidee
flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Blipbug
flavorText: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.

name: Dottler
flavorText: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Orbeetle
flavorText: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Gossifleur
flavorText: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

name: Eldegoss
flavorText: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

name: Wooloo
flavorText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
flavorText: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Chewtle
flavorText: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Drednaw
flavorText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Yamper
flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Boltund
flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Carkol
flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
flavorText: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Applin

evolvesTo.description: Use a Tart Apple on it
Use a Sweet Apple on it
Use a Syrupy Apple on it

flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.

name: Flapple
flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Appletun
flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Silicobra
flavorText: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

name: Sandaconda
flavorText: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: Cramorant
flavorText: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Sizzlipede
flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Clobbopus
flavorText: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct
flavorText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Sinistea

evolvesTo.description: Use a Cracked Pot on it

flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Polteageist
flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Hatenna
flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Impidimp
flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Obstagoon
